model.title: A resolution expressing the sense of the Senate regarding the importance of religious freedom, authoritative texts, and transparency in artificial intelligence systems.

summary.text: The resolution states the Senate's view that religious freedom is a central constitutional liberty for everyone and that bias against people based on their religion or lack of religion harms a free and just society. It encourages organizations that build or run artificial intelligence systems to adopt consistent standards that respect religious freedom and transparency. It supports AI systems that give thorough and fairly representative answers to religious questions. It also encourages people to consult sacred texts, authoritative writings, and religious leaders to understand religious beliefs and traditions.
